card.title: Fizzl Agent Wallet
card.sub: Your agents pay. You set the rules.

segments.text: Meet the Fizzl Agent Wallet. Your agents pay for what they need. You decide the rules.
Set one simple rule. Agents pay on their own up to five dollars per purchase, within one daily budget for all of them.
Anything above your rule waits for you. You see what the agent wants to buy, and why.
On your phone too: one tap on Telegram to approve or deny. No answer means no payment.
Approve it, and the agent goes ahead.
Here is why it is safe. Your agent keeps its own key. Before it signs anything, it asks the wallet, and the wallet only says yes or no.
Every signature is checked first by presign-guard. Known drainers, sanctioned addresses, unlimited approvals: a red verdict is never signed.
And when in doubt, it stops. If a check or the wallet can't be reached, nothing is signed.
Every purchase shows up in one list: what was bought, by which agent, and for how much.
Open one, and the receipt explains it in plain words: the safety check, your rules, the payment, and what your agent got back.
Connect Claude, Cursor or your own code with one key per agent. Pause or remove any agent with one click.
